name: zhubajie-mcp
description: Zhubajie (猪八戒) (marketplaces): me, list_products, list_sales, list_refunds. Every tool maps to a doc

platform_mcp_zhubajie_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZHUBAJIE_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_zhubajie_app_key.description: appKey (应用证书) of your approved ZOP application (open.zbj.com > 控制台).

platform_mcp_zhubajie_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZHUBAJIE_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_zhubajie_app_secret.description: Application secret (应用密钥); signs every call as uppercase hex SHA1 of secret + params sorted by name + secret (签名算法). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_zhubajie_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZHUBAJIE_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_zhubajie_access_token.description: accessToken (访问令牌) from the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation of your 猪八戒 服务商 account (https://open.zbj.com/wiki/getWikiCategoryAll?wikiId=8): valid 7 days by default (refresh at http://openapi.zbj.com/oauth2/refreshtoken), or for the purchase period for 工具市场 apps.

platform_mcp_zhubajie_openid.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZHUBAJIE_OPENID
platform_mcp_zhubajie_openid.description: Your 猪八戒 openid (用户唯一标识, returned with the access token by the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation); every service-provider method takes it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: zbj.user.getServiceUserInfo (openid): nickname, username, mobile, userEmail, brandname (shop name) and openid of the authorised 服务商.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: zbj.service.getServiceList: the 服务商's services (state 1 全部 is always requested; the status filter is not applied). state: 2 出售中, 3 已下架, 4 未通过审核; amount is the web price in CNY (amountApp the app price); sales = successful deals; addtime/lasttime are epoch seconds.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: zbj.trade.querySoldServices: service orders sold by the 服务商 (taskId, title, taskMode 11 购买服务 / 12 雇佣, taskState 0 草稿 … 4 结束并打款, amount and hostedAmount in CNY, createtime epoch seconds, employer nickname). since maps to startTime (yyyyMMddHHmmss); orders carry no service id, so product_id is not applied.

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: zbj.trade.getRefundList: refund requests on the 服务商's trades. refundState 1 待确认退款, 2 退款成功, 3 退款关闭, 4 已拒绝, 5 已撤销, 6 退款处理中; refundAmount (requested) and paidAmount in CNY; createTime epoch seconds. The page size is fixed by the platform (limit and since are not applied).
